_comment: REAL SHAPE, REAL NUMBERS. The `extra_usage` block of `/api/organizations/{org}/usage`, as it came back on the owner's own account (dev-only values dump, 2026-09-10). This is a fragment of the primary usage payload, not a separate endpoint's body — the `overage_spend_limit` supplement that used to fetch this is gone, because the figure was here all along.
_comment_scale: used_credits is MINOR units and decimal_places states the scale: 962 at 2 places is 9.62, NOT 962. monthly_limit is null — extra usage is switched ON with no cap at all, which is why MoneyDetail.limit is nullable and why this row shows an amount with no bar and no percentage. `currency` is the one string value kept real (three characters, and a currency code is not an identifier).
